trips.status: Live recheck 26 Nov 2026 around 09:40 WIB: all KAI trains priced and seat-checked on booking.kai.id for 3-6 Dec, bus checked live on tiket.com for 4 and 6 Dec. tips: Other train classes: from 1 Dec the only Economy train from Jakarta to Jogja in the new timetable is Progo (about Rp330k). Fajar Utama Yogyakarta also has Economy, about Rp330k by an old listing. Everything else is Executive, about Rp590k-740k.
Nearby days: the same trains run daily, so leaving Dec 3 or Dec 4 only changes hotel nights. I found no date-specific fare listing, so check Dec 3 and Dec 4 on booking.kai.id.
Bus and shuttle fares come from articles dated Feb to Aug 2026, not December. Check the operator before relying on them.
